blurb: Guests can join public cruises such as brunch, dinner shows, and themed events or book private cruises for corporate events, weddings, and parties. Cruises range from 90 minutes to 3 hours and include narrated tours and live entertainment. The fleet includes three boats accommodating groups from 6 to 230 guests.

quotes.author: Mr-H-Traveler
quotes.text: Great experience working with Wayzata Bay Charters in putting together and delivering on our recent team outing. Everyone shared what a great time it was, and how much they enjoyed it! Thank you Mark & the crew!

quotes.author: Melissa M
quotes.text: We had a wonderful drinks/chips and salsa cruise with a group of local and international ladies earlier this month. Absolutely wonderful option for a get together or event!

quotes.author: Lynn H
quotes.text: This was just a very pleasant trip on the lake for about an hour. We have recommended to friends and if they had a longer trip would love to go on it.

quotes.author: rosanne03
quotes.text: We enjoyed the one hour cruise. Friendly staff, great information. If they offered a longer cruise I would book it also!
